g.text: COMMERCIAL BANK NIGERIA PLC — ENTERPRISE INFRASTRUCTURE ARCHITECTURE (v3.0)
Core Banking: Infosys Finacle 11.x (On-Prem) | Digital Banking: Huawei Cloud CCE | Data Platform: Databricks Lakehouse | Zero Crossing Orthogonal Bus Routing

g.title:
1. Digital & Physical Customer Channels [Access Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The omnichannel engagement layer serving retail, SME, and corporate banking customers across native mobile apps, responsive web portals, feature-phone USSD (*XYZ#), merchant POS terminals, branch ATMs, and social messaging channels (WhatsApp/Webchat).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Functions as the customer front door. It captures customer financial and non-financial intents, enforces device-level security (biometrics, 2FA, binary obfuscation), and securely routes traffic to cloud ingress or on-prem switching engines.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Retail Customers (iOS/Android), Corporate Treasurers (Web EV-SSL), Telco Subscribers (*XYZ#) • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud WAF & API Gateway (HTTPS 443), Telco Aggregators (SMPP 2775), Postilion Switch (ISO 8583 Port 9000) • FAILOVER: BGP Anycast DNS, multi-telco dual-SIM failover on POS/ATMs, multi-AZ cloud WAF ingestion. • SECURITY: GuardSquare DexGuard/iXGuard, FIDO2 biometrics, SafeToken 2FA, DUKPT PIN encryption, PCI-DSS Level 1 terminal certs. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

Retail Mobile Banking App (iOS & Android) [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Native consumer mobile banking applications published on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store for daily retail banking operations.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Allows retail customers to register accounts, check balances, transfer funds via NIP, buy airtime/data, pay utilities, and manage debit cards from smartphones.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Retail Banking Customers via Touch/FaceID • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud WAF & Kong API Gateway via HTTPS / TLS 1.3 (Port 443) • FAILOVER: BGP Anycast routing to redundant Cloud WAF endpoints. • SECURITY: GuardSquare DexGuard & iXGuard binary code obfuscation, root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, and FIDO2 biometric authentication. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: App Store & Google Play Store Native Applications
• Ingress Target: Huawei Cloud WAF & Kong API Gateway

g.title:
Corporate & SME Internet Banking Portal [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Responsive enterprise web banking portal designed for commercial business accounts, SME managers, and corporate treasury departments.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enables multi-tiered maker-checker workflows, bulk salary payroll processing, commercial FX purchases, trade finance letters of credit, and corporate statement exports.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Corporate Treasurers & SME Directors via Web Browsers • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud WAF & Corporate Ingress via HTTPS / TLS 1.3 (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Multi-region cloud web servers behind Cloud WAF and elastic load balancers. • SECURITY: Extended Validation SSL (EV-SSL), Content Security Policy (CSP), SafeToken hardware/software 2FA (Maxut), and dual-approval transaction limits. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Responsive Web Portal for Enterprise Treasury & Bulk
• Maker-Checker Workflow with Batch Payroll Ingestion

g.title:
USSD Banking Channel (*XYZ#) [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Interactive session-based USSD financial channel operating on feature phones without requiring internet access or smartphones.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Delivers financial inclusion across unbanked and semi-urban populations in Nigeria for rapid balance checks, airtime top-ups, and instant transfers.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Mobile Subscribers on MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9mobile dialing *XYZ# • OUTBOUND: Telco Aggregators via SMPP Protocol over IPsec VPN (Port 2775), Huawei Cloud USSD State Service • FAILOVER: Multi-aggregator routing failover; automated fallback between telco SMPP gateways. • SECURITY: Thales payShield 10K hardware HSM for PIN translation, ephemeral 90-second session state timeouts, and daily velocity transaction caps. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Protocol: SMPP over Telco Aggregator VPN circuits
• Session Handling: Cloud USSD Session State Engine

g.title:
POS & Agency Banking Terminals [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Fleet of Android SmartPOS and traditional Linux payment terminals deployed at merchant locations and agency banking kiosks across Nigeria.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Facilitates in-person card payments, merchant POS acquiring, cash-in/cash-out agency banking, and bill payments using debit/credit cards.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Cardholders inserting Verve, Mastercard, or Visa cards • OUTBOUND: Postilion Financial Switch & Interswitch via ISO 8583 over IPsec VPN (Ports 9000-9100) • FAILOVER: Multi-telco dual-SIM roaming (MTN/Airtel/Glo) on all POS terminals with sub-second failover. • SECURITY: DUKPT (Derived Unique Key Per Transaction) PIN encryption, PCI-PTS certified hardware, and Terminal Management System (TMS) remote key injection. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Connection: Dedicated APN SIMs (MTN, Airtel, Glo)
• Security: DUKPT PIN Encryption, TMS Remote Key

g.title:
Branch & Offsite ATM Fleet [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Multifunction cash dispenser and cash deposit automated teller machines (ATMs) deployed at bank branches, offsite shopping malls, and airports.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Provides 24/7 cash withdrawals, cash deposits, cardless ATM payouts, PIN changes, and mini-statement printing.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Cardholders inserting chip cards & inputting 4-digit PINs • OUTBOUND: Postilion Financial Switch via ISO 8583 over Shivtech Managed IPsec Routers (Port 9000) • FAILOVER: Dual cellular SIM wireless backhaul (Shivtech) backed by branch metro fiber. • SECURITY: Triple-DES (3DES) / AES PIN pads, Cencon digital vault locks, anti-skimming sensors, and physical CCTV DVR recording. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • OEM: NCR / Diebold Nixdorf with Cencon Locks
• Network: Dedicated Dual SIM IPsec VPN (Shivtech)

g.title:
Social Channels & Conversational AI [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Conversational banking gateway connecting official WhatsApp Business accounts, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat with AI chatbots and live agents.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Allows customers to interactively query balances, transfer money, purchase airtime, and escalate complex disputes to Contact Center call center agents.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Customers messaging official bank WhatsApp Business account (+234...) • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud CCE Notification & Chat Services via Webhook HTTPS (Port 443), Avaya CCaaS Contact Center for live agent handoff • FAILOVER: Meta Cloud multi-region API infrastructure with redundant webhook endpoints. • SECURITY: End-to-end encryption via WhatsApp Business API, OTP verification for financial actions, and secure tokenization of customer identities. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: WhatsApp Business Banking, Webchat, Social Bots
• WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta Official Partner)
• Omnichannel Bot: Avaya Social / Infinite Gold
• Target: Huawei Cloud CCE Notification & Chat Microservices

g.title:
IAM / 2FA Auth Suite (SafeToken & iToken) [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Hardware and software multi-factor authentication (MFA) suite supplied by Maxut Consulting Limited for identity verification.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enforces second-factor challenge-response tokens during internet banking logins and high-value transactions, preventing credential stuffing and unauthorized fund movement.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Customer Portal Logins and Transaction Authorization requests • OUTBOUND: Identity & Auth Microservice on Huawei Cloud via REST API (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Dual-datacenter authentication server redundancy; software push notification fallback to SMS OTP. • SECURITY: Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) algorithm, cryptographic hardware seed encryption, and Microsoft Entra ID role federation. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Protocol: TOTP / Push Notification / Hardware OTP

g.title:
2. Huawei Cloud Platform (Digital Platform & Workflows) [Cloud Workload Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Hosts containerized digital banking microservices on Cloud Container Engine (CCE), Temporal distributed saga workflow orchestrations, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL & GaussDB, Redis cache, and DMS Kafka event streaming backbone.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Executes digital customer journeys with cloud-scale elastic agility. Handles digital identity, card controls, transfers, bills, and notifications without placing transactional read load on core banking systems.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Customer Channels via Cloud WAF (HTTPS 443), Telco Aggregators via SMPP (Port 2775), Head Office Admins via Forcepoint SWG (Port 443) • OUTBOUND: Core Middleware on-prem via 1 Gbps Direct Connect MPLS (mTLS Port 443), Databricks Lakehouse via Kafka (Port 9092), Prisma Cloud & QualysGuard APIs (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Multi-AZ active-standby database replication (AZ1/AZ2) with <30s automatic failover, auto-scaled read replicas, and CCE multi-zone Kubernetes node pools. • SECURITY: Dedicated hardware KMS Customer Master Keys, Istio mTLS zero-trust pod mesh, OWASP Top 10 WAF, and Prisma Cloud container runtime security. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 2. HUAWEI CLOUD WORKLOAD — DIGITAL BANKING PLATFORM, WORKFLOWS & CLOUD DATA

g.title: Huawei Cloud WAF
Advanced Anti-DDoS
Enterprise API Gateway
NAT Gateway & EIP Pool
Prisma Cloud CSPM Agent
KMS / CSMS Secrets Management

g.text: Digital Banking Spring Boot Microservices (Multi-AZ Deployment)
Read path: Cloud Read Replica & Redis Cache
Integrates with Maxut SafeToken & NIMC API
Direct Connect to Core Middleware & Switch
Card blocking, PIN change, limits, virtual cards
Airtime, Disco power tokens, cable TV, betting
Transaction alert SMS, email statements, push

g.title:
Temporal Workflow Orchestration Platform [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Durable distributed saga state machine coordinator running on Kubernetes with dedicated workers for statements, reconciliation, KYC refresh, and standing orders.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Coordinates multi-step distributed financial sagas (e.g. debit sender account in Finacle -> call external NIBSS NIP -> confirm credit or execute automated compensation rollback on timeout).
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Digital Microservices via gRPC (Port 7233) • OUTBOUND: Cloud RDS PostgreSQL Temporal DB via PostgreSQL Wire (Port 5432), Core Middleware via Direct Connect (mTLS Port 443) • FAILOVER: Clustered Temporal history and matching services across multi-AZ; resilient state persistence with zero lost steps. • SECURITY: Internal VPC private subnet isolation, mTLS gRPC communication, and encrypted workflow state payloads. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Durable distributed saga state machine coordinator for complex banking flows:
• Interbank Transfer Saga: Debit Finacle -> Call NIBSS NIP -> Compensate on timeout
• Digital Onboarding Saga: NIMC NIN Verification -> BVN check -> Finacle CIF creation
• Loan Origination Workflow: Credit Bureau query -> Risk scoring -> Disbursement
• Backing Persistence: Multi-AZ PostgreSQL & Redis State

g.title:
Huawei DMS Kafka Event Streaming Backbone [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Managed Apache Kafka message bus cluster deployed across 3 Availability Zones with dedicated partitions for financial event topics.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: The enterprise event backbone connecting microservices asynchronously, buffering transaction events (`tx-events`), and streaming real-time CDC updates into Databricks Delta Lake Bronze.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Payment, Account, and Card Microservices via Kafka Wire (Port 9092) • OUTBOUND: Databricks Delta Lake Bronze Ingestion (Port 9092), On-Prem Kafka via MirrorMaker 2 over Direct Connect (Port 9092) • FAILOVER: 3-broker multi-AZ cluster with replication factor 3; zero message loss with min.insync.replicas=2. • SECURITY: SASL_SSL SCRAM-SHA-512 authentication, TLS 1.3 in-transit encryption, and topic-level ACLs. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Huawei Distributed Message Service (DMS Kafka Event Mesh)
Enterprise Event Backbone for Cloud Microservices & Data Streaming:
• Core Topics: tx-events, customer-audit, notification-queue, cdc-streams
• Multi-AZ Cluster with 3 Brokers + MirrorMaker cross-region replication
• Feeds Real-Time Ingestion into Databricks Delta Lake Bronze Layer

g.title: Platform Observability & Service Mesh
g.text: • Istio Service Mesh: Mutual TLS (mTLS) zero-trust pod-to-pod encryption
• Application Performance Monitoring (APM): Distributed tracing & latency tracking
• Cloud Eye & Log Tank Service (LTS): Centralized syslog ingestion with 1-year retention

g.title: Cloud Hybrid Gateway
g.text: Cloud Hybrid Gateway (Direct Connect & IPsec Terminator)
• Dedicated Direct Connect 1 Gbps MPLS terminating to Primary DC on-prem
• Failover: Automated BGP failover to IPsec VPN tunnel over public internet
• mTLS Core API Client communicating with on-prem Core Middleware

g.title:
Huawei Cloud RDS PostgreSQL & GaussDB (Multi-AZ) [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Enterprise managed relational database deployed in Active-Standby configuration across Availability Zone 1 (AZ1 Master) and Availability Zone 2 (AZ2 Standby).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Stores digital customer profiles, onboarding draft applications, session metadata, notification queues, and workflow state for the digital banking platform.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: CCE Microservices via PostgreSQL Wire (Port 5432) • OUTBOUND: AZ2 Hot Standby via Synchronous Block Replication, Auto-Scaled Read Replicas via Streaming Replication, Databricks Delta Lake Bronze via Kafka CDC (Port 9092) • FAILOVER: Synchronous block-level replication with automated heartbeat failover in < 30 seconds (RPO = 0). • SECURITY: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) with KMS CMK, SSL/TLS 1.3 enforced connections, and continuous audit logging to CyberSOC Africa. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Huawei Cloud RDS for PostgreSQL & GaussDB
Primary transactional database for digital customer profiles & session state:
• CDC Source: Logical Replication Stream to Kafka & Databricks

g.title:
Cloud Read-Only Replicas (AZ1 & AZ2) [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Horizontally scalable read-only database replicas deployed in AZ1 and AZ2 behind an internal database load balancer.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Offloads 85%+ of read-intensive customer operations (balance inquiries, mini-statements, transaction search) to prevent CPU and lock contention on the primary transactional master.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Account & Statement Microservices via PostgreSQL Wire (Port 5432) • OUTBOUND: Synchronized from Primary Master via Asynchronous Streaming Replication (lag < 100ms) • FAILOVER: Auto-scaling read replica pool; unhealthy replicas automatically detached by internal load balancer. • SECURITY: Read-only database role credentials, strict network security group isolation, and KMS encryption at rest. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Horizontally scalable read query offload for mobile/web inquiries:
• Offloads 85%+ of read traffic: Account balance, statement generation, transaction history
• Asynchronous streaming replication from Primary Master (lag < 100ms)
• Auto-scaled behind internal database load balancer

g.title:
DCS Redis Enterprise (Multi-AZ Master-Replica) [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: High-performance in-memory caching cluster deployed in Multi-AZ Master-Replica mode with automated Sentinel failover.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Delivers sub-millisecond retrieval of active customer login JWTs, OTP challenge states, API consumer rate limiting counters, and branch master lists.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: API Gateway & Microservices via RESP protocol (Port 6379) • OUTBOUND: In-Memory replication to AZ2 Standby Replica • FAILOVER: Automated Sentinel failover to AZ2 replica in < 5 seconds; dual persistence with Append-Only File (AOF) and hourly RDB snapshots. • SECURITY: Redis AUTH password authentication, TLS encrypted transport, and private subnet placement. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: In-Memory caching & high-speed session token management:
• Master in AZ1 with synchronous in-memory replication to Replica in AZ2
• Sub-millisecond latency for OTP verification, login tokens & API rate limiting
• Dual persistence: Append-Only File (AOF) + RDB snapshot every hour

g.title:
Cloud Backup and Recovery (CBR) & OBS WORM Archive [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Comprehensive cloud data protection suite managing automated database snapshots, cross-region replication, and long-term cold storage.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Guarantees point-in-time recovery (PITR) for all cloud databases, protects against cloud regional disasters, and complies with CBN financial record retention directives.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Cloud RDS PostgreSQL & GaussDB via Continuous Log Shipping (every 15 min) • OUTBOUND: Secondary Huawei Cloud Region via Cross-Region Snapshot Sync, Cloud OBS Archive Tier via WORM Object Lock (7-Year Retention) • FAILOVER: Multi-region snapshot availability; one-click point-in-time database restoration. • SECURITY: KMS Customer Master Key encryption, immutable WORM (Write Once, Read Many) bucket policies, and NDPA 2023 compliance. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

g.text: Transaction log backups captured every 15 minutes; 35-day restore window
Daily database snapshots replicated to secondary cloud region (Protection against regional outage)
Monthly cold exports in KMS-encrypted OBS with Object Lock (7-year CBN retention)
• Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) at rest with dedicated KMS Customer Master Key
• SSL/TLS 1.3 enforced for all microservice connections with strict certificate pinning
• Automated vulnerability scanning via QualysGuard & Prisma Cloud CSPM
• Database audit logs streamed continuously to CyberSOC Africa SIEM

g.title:
11. Enterprise Data Lakehouse & Databricks Data Engineering [Data & Analytics Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Unified lakehouse platform powered by Databricks on Cloud with Delta Lake storage (Cloud OBS/S3). Features Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), Unity Catalog governance, Delta Live Tables (DLT), Photon SQL engine, and MLflow.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Centralizes bank-wide data intelligence. Ingests real-time transactional redo logs from on-prem core banking and cloud databases, consolidates customer 360 golden records, automates CBN/NDIC regulatory returns, and powers real-time AML fraud detection.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Oracle 19c RAC via GoldenGate/Kafka CDC (Port 9092 over Direct Connect), Cloud RDS PostgreSQL via Logical CDC (Port 9092), Batch EOD GL Dumps & NIBSS Journals via SFTP (Port 22) • OUTBOUND: Power BI & Executive Dashboards via Photon JDBC/ODBC (Port 443), Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN Extranet e-FASS/S4), Finacle Core Fraud Alerts via REST API • FAILOVER: Serverless auto-scaling compute clusters across availability zones; Delta Lake ACID transactions with time-travel and multi-AZ object storage. • SECURITY: Unity Catalog fine-grained row-level filtering and dynamic column-level PII masking for BVN/NIN compliance with Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA 2023). (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

Bronze Layer (Raw Ingestion / Landing Zone) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Append-only raw data landing zone in Delta Lake storing pristine copies of incoming data with original schemas and timestamps.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Ingests real-time CDC redo logs from on-premise Oracle 19c RAC (via GoldenGate/Kafka) and Cloud RDS PostgreSQL, alongside batch EOD general ledger flat files.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Oracle 19c RAC CDC via Kafka Connect (TLS Port 9092 over Direct Connect), Cloud RDS CDC via Kafka (Port 9092), Batch EOD files via SFTP (Port 22) • OUTBOUND: Silver Layer via Delta Live Tables (DLT) streaming pipelines • FAILOVER: Cloud Object Storage (OBS/S3) durability (99.999999999%); Delta Lake ACID transaction log. • SECURITY: Server-side KMS encryption, append-only bucket policies, and immutable audit timestamps. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Streaming Change Data Capture (CDC) from On-Prem Oracle 19c RAC (GoldenGate redo logs)
• Cloud Database CDC from Huawei Cloud RDS PostgreSQL & GaussDB via Kafka Connect
• Raw clickstream, mobile telemetry, and EOD batch dumps stored with zero transformation

g.title:
Silver Layer (Cleaned, Conformed Customer 360) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Cleaned, schema-validated, and conformed single source of truth across all banking entities.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Constructs the enterprise Customer 360 golden record by joining Finacle CIF, NIMC NIN, BVN, and Card IDs with automated deduplication and data cleansing.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Bronze Layer via Delta Live Tables (DLT) Declarative Quality Rules • OUTBOUND: Gold Layer Aggregated Marts via Apache Spark DAGs • FAILOVER: Delta Lake time-travel and schema evolution; automated reprocessing from Bronze. • SECURITY: Unity Catalog dynamic column-level PII masking for BVN, NIN, and Card PAN; role-based access control (RBAC). (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Deduplicated, schema-validated, and conformed single source of truth
• Customer 360 Master Data Management (linking Finacle CIF, NIMC NIN, BVN, and card IDs)
• Validated transaction history, general ledger postings, and normalized currency rates

g.title:
Gold Layer (Aggregated Business & Regulatory Marts) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Highly optimized dimensional data marts, pre-calculated aggregates, and feature stores modeled for business intelligence and regulatory compliance.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Directly feeds Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN e-FASS/S4) returns, NDIC risk reports, executive profitability dashboards, and MLflow fraud scoring engines.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Silver Layer via Scheduled Databricks Workflows and Spark Jobs • OUTBOUND: Databricks SQL & Photon Query Engine for Power BI (Port 443), CBN Extranet Reporting Gateway, MLflow Model Serving • FAILOVER: Pre-computed parquet delta tables with partition pruning and Z-order indexing for instant failover recovery. • SECURITY: Unity Catalog row-level security ensuring branch managers and department heads only view authorized business entities. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Executive KPI & Profitability Dashboards, Daily Liquidity Reporting, Product Analytics
• Automated Regulatory Returns: Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN e-FASS / S4) & NDIC reporting
• High-performance Feature Stores for ML models: Credit scoring, churn, fraud propensity

g.title:
Unity Catalog (Unified Governance & Security) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Centralized governance engine managing metadata, access permissions, data lineage, and audit trails across all Lakehouse tables, models, and files.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enforces bank-wide compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA 2023) and CBN cyber regulations by automating PII masking and tracking complete data lineage from source to report.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Databricks Workspace Users, Service Principals, and Power BI Connectors • OUTBOUND: Enforces access control policies across Bronze, Silver, Gold Delta Lake tables • FAILOVER: Provider-managed cloud multi-region catalog metadata replication. • SECURITY: Centralized audit log ingestion into CyberSOC Africa SIEM, row/column masking, and NDPA compliance audits. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Centralized governance across all data, AI models, dashboards, and files:
• Fine-Grained Access Control: Row-level filtering and column-level masking for PII (BVN, NIN, Card PAN)
• End-to-End Data Lineage: Automated tracking from source tables (Oracle/PostgreSQL) to Gold dashboards
• Regulatory Compliance: Centralized audit logs for Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and CBN audits
• Storage Layer: Cloud Object Storage (OBS / S3) with Server-Side KMS Encryption & IAM Access

g.title:
9. Non Self-Hosted Enterprise Applications (SaaS) [Enterprise SaaS Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Consolidates 14 specialized third-party hosted software-as-a-service (SaaS) and managed security solutions, including Microsoft 365, Bloomberg Professional, Refinitiv (FIFX), Diligent BoardEffect, Zoho ATS, Kahoot!, Adroit Iconcept 4, QualysGuard, Portnox CLEAR, Prisma Cloud, CyberSOC Africa, Ultracrest, and SWIFT.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Empowers executive governance, treasury capital markets dealing, enterprise risk, corporate office productivity, staff talent learning, and 24/7 managed cyber defense without on-premises hardware overhead.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Head Office & Branch Users via Forcepoint SWG (HTTPS 443), Treasury Dealing Desks via Dedicated Leased Circuits (Ports 8194 & 443), Primary DC & Cloud Telemetry via Mutual TLS (Ports 443 & 6514) • OUTBOUND: Primary DC Calypso Treasury via B-PIPE feed, Corporate Ingress via Entra ID SAML 2.0 Identity Federation • FAILOVER: Provider-managed global multi-region SaaS redundancy, redundant leased circuits for treasury data feeds, and local caching on endpoints. • SECURITY: Microsoft Entra ID SAML 2.0 SSO, Forcepoint CASB/DLP policy enforcement, Delinea PAM privileged access monitoring, and air-gapped dedicated hosting. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

g.text: • Access: Entra ID SAML SSO / Forcepoint SWG
Financial Market Terminals & B-PIPE Data Feed
• Dedicated Router: Leased Circuits to London DC
• Dedicated Leased Lines to Primary DC
• Secure Cloud SaaS with Entra ID MFA
• Operational Risk Registers, KRIs, Audit Tracking
• Cloud-Hosted SaaS Model with Bank SSO
• Continuous Asset Discovery across all IPs
• Zero-Trust Branch & Head Office Port Security
• CWPP Protection for Huawei Cloud CCE
Dedicated Cloud Hosting for Corporate Website
• Fully Air-Gapped from Core Banking Systems
• CSCF Dedicated Enclave in Primary DC
Forcepoint SWG / CASB, Entra ID SSO, Delinea
• Microsoft Entra ID SAML 2.0 Identity Federation

g.title:
10. Nigerian Financial Ecosystem, Regulators & Telecom Carriers [External Ecosystem Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Encompasses the mandatory national payment rails (NIBSS Instant Payments, NACS, BVN), the banking regulator (Central Bank of Nigeria Extranet RTGS/CRMS/S4), Interswitch payment gateway, NIMC identity verification, and 14 contracted telecom carrier networks.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enables interbank clearing, instant fund transfers, national settlement, regulatory supervision compliance, card acquiring, and telecom WAN transport across Nigeria.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Postilion Switch via ISO 8583 (Ports 9000-9100), Core Middleware via Secure HTTPS (Port 443), Branch SD-WAN via MPLS/Cellular Underlays • OUTBOUND: Finacle Core Banking Settlement Accounts, Beneficiary Banks across Nigerian Financial System • FAILOVER: Dual redundant MPLS circuits to NIBSS data centers (Victoria Island & Ikeja), 14 contracted telcos ensuring carrier diversity, and automated BGP routing failover. • SECURITY: Dedicated private MPLS leased lines, hardware HSM MAC verification, 3DES/AES PIN translation, and strict IP whitelisting. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 10. NIGERIAN FINANCIAL ECOSYSTEM, REGULATORS & TELECOM CARRIERS
National payment clearing house & instant settlement rail:
• NIBSS Instant Payments (NIP): Real-time interbank credit transfer (ISO 8583 / REST)
• BVN Validation Service: Real-time Biometric Verification Number identity verification
• NACS Automated Clearing: Cheque clearing and Direct Debit settlement
• Connection: Dedicated MPLS circuits to NIBSS Victoria Island & Ikeja Data Centers
Apex regulatory extranet network & high-value RTGS settlement:
• Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS): High-value interbank inter-account settlement
• CRMS / Credit Bureau: Mandatory Credit Risk Management System reporting
• S4 Regulatory Reporting: Daily liquidity ratios, foreign exchange returns
National card switching & digital merchant acquiring:
• Verve Card Acquiring: Real-time domestic debit card transaction routing
• Quickteller & Webpay: Merchant online payment gateway & bills processing
• Connection: Dual redundant cross-connect to Primary DC Postilion Switch
• Real-time National Identification Number (NIN) authentication via secure API
• Mandatory tier-3 KYC compliance requirement for account opening
• Encrypted TLS 1.3 VPN tunnel to NIMC verification gateway
• SMPP USSD Aggregation: Sessions routed to Huawei Cloud USSD Service
• Bulk SMS Notifications: High-throughput transactional alert delivery
• SIP Voice Trunks: Inbound/outbound call routing to Avaya Call Center
• Protocol: SMPP over IPsec VPN / SIP over TLS
• Metro Fiber Ring in Victoria Island / Lekki
• Connecting Primary DC to DR DC
• Dedicated Private APN for POS Terminals
DEDICATED INTER-TIER BACKBONE CORRIDOR — ALL BUSES ROUTED HERE WITHOUT SECTION CROSSING

HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Primary DC Oracle RAC via Active Data Guard (Port 1521 over DCI Dark Fiber), Primary Data Domain via DD Boost Async (Port 2051) • OUTBOUND: Montgomery Vaults (Lagos) via weekly armored courier transport of LTO-8 tapes, Failover to Branch & Cloud routers upon DR activation • FAILOVER: Fast-Start Failover (FSFO) with independent cloud observer node (RPO=0, RTO<5 min); VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM) automated application restart. • SECURITY: Subterranean gas-suppressed climate-controlled vault storage, air-gapped from IP networks to eliminate ransomware vectors. • Carries Core Banking API traffic, Kafka streams, and Databricks CDC pipelines
Encrypted Fallback Transport over Public Internet:
• AES-256 GCM encrypted tunnel running over diverse telco internet backhauls
• BGP Route health monitoring with automated sub-second failover on Direct Connect failure
• Terminated on Fortinet FortiGate enterprise cluster in Primary DC

g.title:
Inter-DC Dark Fiber Ring (DCI Interconnect) [Section 3: Hybrid Connectivity] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: High-bandwidth, ultra-low latency (<2ms round-trip) metro dark fiber ring connecting the Primary Data Center (Lekki) to the Secondary DR Data Center (Ikeja).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Transports synchronous block-level database redo logs for Oracle Active Data Guard with guaranteed zero data loss (RPO = 0), alongside Dell Data Domain backup replication.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Primary DC Oracle 19c RAC Nodes and Dell Data Domain • OUTBOUND: Secondary DR DC Oracle Standby (Port 1521) and DR Data Domain (Port 2051) • FAILOVER: Dual-routed physical fiber paths provided by Broadbased Communications and 21st Century Technologies with automated optical switching. • SECURITY: Private dedicated dark fiber cores with hardware-level optical wiretap protection. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
